title: Advanced Relative Clauses
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Ahora puedes usar 'whom' y 'whose' correctamente, y sabes cuándo omitir los pronombres relativos. Tu inglés suena muy natural y profesional.

parts.visual:
Whom vs Who: 
- 'Who' es el SUJETO (hace la acción). 
Ej: The man WHO signed the contract is the CEO. 
- 'Whom' es el OBJETO (recibe la acción). Se usa mucho después de preposiciones (to whom, with whom). 
Ej: The client WITH WHOM I was speaking is very angry.
parts.audio: Whom versus Who. 'Who' is the subject, the person doing the action. For example: The man who signed the contract is the CEO. 'Whom' is the object, the person receiving the action. It is often used after prepositions like 'to whom' or 'with whom'. For example: The client with whom I was speaking is very angry.

parts.visual:
Whose vs Omisión: 
- 'Whose' indica posesión (cuyo/cuya). 
Ej: The employee WHOSE laptop was stolen reported it to IT. 
- Omitir el pronombre: Si 'who/which/that' es el OBJETO de la oración, puedes omitirlo para sonar más natural. 
Ej: The email (THAT) I sent yesterday was urgent -> The email I sent yesterday was urgent.
parts.audio: Whose versus Omission. 'Whose' indicates possession. For example: The employee whose laptop was stolen reported it to IT. Omitting the pronoun: If who, which, or that, is the object of the sentence, you can omit it to sound more natural. For example: The email that I sent yesterday was urgent, becomes: The email I sent yesterday was urgent.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el pronombre relativo avanzado o la omisión correcta.

questions.question: To ____ it may concern: (A quien corresponda - formal).
questions.explanation: Después de la preposición 'To' se usa 'whom'.

questions.question: The manager ____ office is on the 5th floor is not here. (Cuya).
questions.explanation: Whose indica posesión (la oficina del manager).

questions.question: The woman with ____ I was negotiating is the CEO. (Con la que / Con quien).
The project ____ we finished last week was a success. (Que - objeto).
questions.explanation: Como el proyecto es el objeto (nosotros lo terminamos), podemos omitir el 'that/which'.

questions.question: The engineer ____ fixed the server saved us. (Quien - sujeto).
questions.explanation: El ingeniero hizo la acción (fixed), así que es el sujeto (who). No se puede omitir.

questions.question: Is there anyone ____ needs a copy of the report? (Que necesite).
questions.explanation: Anyone es el sujeto del verbo 'needs', usamos 'who'.

questions.question: The company ____ shares we bought is doing well. (Cuyas acciones).
The person to ____ you sent the email has resigned. (A quien).
The report ____ I read yesterday had many errors. (Que - objeto).
questions.explanation: El reporte es el objeto de lo que leí. Se puede omitir.

questions.question: He is a leader ____ vision inspires everyone. (Cuya visión).
questions.explanation: Whose vision = la visión de él.

questions.question: Those ____ have not signed must do it today. (Aquellos que).
questions.explanation: Sujeto de la acción (tienen que firmar).

questions.question: The board members, many of ____ were absent, delayed the vote. (Muchos de los cuales).
questions.explanation: Después de 'many of' (preposición) referida a personas, usamos 'whom'.

questions.question: The meeting ____ we attended was very boring. (A la que asistimos).
questions.explanation: Se puede omitir 'which/that' porque nosotros somos el sujeto que asistió.

questions.question: The investors ____ money we used are demanding results. (Cuyo dinero).
questions.explanation: Whose money = el dinero de los inversores.

questions.question: He is the candidate about ____ they were talking. (De quien).
The laptop ____ broke yesterday belongs to the boss. (Que se rompió - sujeto).
questions.explanation: Aquí 'which/that' es el sujeto que hizo la acción (romperse), no se puede omitir.

questions.question: I don't know the woman ____ is sitting next to the CEO. (Quien está).
questions.explanation: Ella es el sujeto (está sentada) = who.

questions.question: The consultant ____ advice we followed was brilliant. (Cuyo consejo).
questions.explanation: Whose advice = el consejo del consultor.

questions.question: She is the colleague ____ I trust the most. (A quien - objeto).
questions.explanation: Ella recibe la acción (yo confío en ella), así que formalmente es 'whom'. (En lenguaje hablado informal se acepta 'who' u omisión).

questions.question: The budget ____ they approved is very small. (Que - objeto).
questions.explanation: El presupuesto recibe la acción (ellos lo aprobaron), así que se puede omitir.

questions.question: To ____ it may concern: (A quien)
The man ____ office is here. (Cuya)
The person with ____ I spoke. (Con quien)
The employee ____ did this is fired. (Quien - sujeto)
The clients, many of ____ are angry. (Quienes - después de of)
The manager ____ car is red. (Cuyo)
The candidate about ____ we talked. (De quien)
Anyone ____ needs help should ask. (Que/Quien - sujeto)
The company ____ CEO resigned. (Cuyo)
For ____ did you buy this? (Para quien)

pairs.target: Posible si es el objeto de la oración
El que llamó... (No se puede omitir)
